critical_code_review_comments: WaylyHeader silently requires DrawerProvider — consider making useDrawer defensive (return a no-op default when no provider is present) so future reuse outside (tabs) doesn't crash. Not blocking now that onboarding no longer uses WaylyHeader, but a latent trap for any future out-of-tabs screen that imports WaylyHeader.
